defect: stored_value_q has no reset while the history register in the same filter resets
rationale: stored_vector_q is reset to zero but stored_value_q, which drives the filtered output when enabled, has no reset, so its value after reset is undefined until the first stable window.
author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Removed the optional input synchronizer and the unused-bit helper, windowed the history so every stored bit is used.

labels.note: The stored output value lacks reset while the history registers reset.
